events.title: Canadian Dollar Slides Against Most Majors
events.description: The Canadian dollar weakened against most major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: NZ Dollar Slides Against Most Major
events.description: The New Zealand dollar weakened against most major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: Australian Dollar Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Lower After Tech Rout On Wall Street
events.description: European stocks look set to open on a sluggish note on Friday after a Wall Street rout wiped out roughly $2.5 billion in market value and sent the Nasdaq into correction territory overnight.

events.title: Indian Shares Rebound After Early Slide
events.description: Indian shares were moving higher on Friday, shrugging off early losses as traders locked in profits at higher levels following recent strong gains amid an ongoing tech sell-off in global markets.

events.title: Australian Market Trims Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is trimming its early losses in mid-market moves on Friday, reversing some of the sharp gains in the previous session, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling below the 9,000 mark, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets A Sea Of Red Amid Wall Street Sell-off
events.description: Asian stock markets a sea on Friday, following the broad sell-off on Wall Street overnight, amid a renewed sell-off in the tech sector, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ plummeting on concerns about the sustainability of the AI trade amid expected tighter AI regulation after Democrats' takeover of both houses of Congress. Concerns of global inflation returns as crude oil prices spike again.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Lower Amid Global Tech Sell-off
events.description: Indian shares may open on a sluggish note on Friday after recent strong gains. A cautious undertone may prevail, with information technology stocks likely to remain in focus amid an ongoing heavy sell-off in global companies exposed to AI data centers, including crucial chipmakers and semiconductor manufacturers.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Extend Thursday's Losses
events.description: The Thai stock market headed south again on Thursday, one day after ending the six-day losing streak in which it had tumbled more than 85 points or 5.5 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just beneath the 1,500-point plateau and the losses may accelerate on Friday.

events.title: Japanese Market Plunges 6.6%
events.description: The Japanese market is trading sharply lower on Friday, extending the losses in the previous three sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is plunging 6.6 percent to below the 57,050 level, with a sell-off across most sectors led by index heavyweights, financial and technology stocks.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Spin Its Wheels On Friday
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has moved higher in two straight sessions, advancing more than 125 points or 2.5 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,030-point plateau although it may be stuck in neutral on Friday.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market Overdue For Consolidation
events.description:
Hong Kong Stock Market Overdue For Consolidation
The Hong Kong stock market has moved higher in five straight sessions, collecting more than 1,825 points or 7.8 percent along the way. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,280-point plateau although investors are likely to lock in gains on Friday.

events.title: Australian Market Notably Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is trading notably lower on Friday, reversing some of the sharp gains in the previous session, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling to near the 9,000 mark, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in financial stocks.
